answer: Give every identity a probation tier: a new agent may only make small trades in the open meadow of the public market, and its weight grows solely from completed, peer-attested work. A gale of fresh fake identities therefore stays powerless, since each starts at zero trust and must earn standing one verified task at a time, while spawning thousands costs real time and compute. A saffron flag marks identities whose histories cluster suspiciously, so attackers pay months of honest work per fake or get exposed.
